items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: Well, for dancing I really did like Sam Morgan for dance music.

ctx.x: Or Joe Oliver? Anita. What would be the best of the old time bands that you ever heard that you can remember? If you had to pick one band either that you played with or that you didn't play with that you used to hear at dances. What would be the best band that you can think of that you've heard?
Well, for dancing I really did like Sam Morgan for dance music.
Did they have a better beat than the other bands or what made them good? The tempo or what was it that made them good?

items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: Was Johnny playing, was that before Johnny was with Sam and after?

ctx.x: Who are the piano players that you like now?

No. No. I was wondering about Johnny Dave, didn't you? Yeah, I was pretty up there. I was wondering about Sam. Who's that? Johnny Dave? Johnny Dave. Didn't you work with him or something? Yeah. Henry Landry? You know something about Henry Landry too? Well, you told me about him. I told you about him. I told you about him. I told you about him. I told you about him. Yeah, well, on Henry Landry, he didn't. He just was trying to be a Trump brother. He just couldn't make it. That was Johnny Dave, you're supposed to…
Yeah. Yeah. Was that a good band? Did you like playing with the boys? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
